block.guhs.ringh3_rune.lore: Carved out of the wall by Gimguh. Knock on it for a different sign. The nyeg rune glows.
block.guhs.ringh3_brokkelsteen.lore: Holds out exactly long enough. Usually. Keep walking, nyeg!
block.guhs.ringh3_hendel.lore: Springs back all by itself. Dwarf guhs trust nobody with a lever.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.beloning.rune: Four runestones, carved out by Gimguh
gui.guhs.ringh3.poort.schrift: In glowing runes it says: 'The Gate of Durguh, Lord of Nibblemoria. Say nyeg and enter.' What do you say?
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.lees: Runes glow above the gate: 'Say nyeg and enter.' Other than that, nothing happens. Not yet.
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.al_open: The gate still remembers you. It's sliding open already, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.fout.1: The gate pretends it can't hear you. It really does say what you have to say...
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.fout.2: Still shut. Read the spell again, VERY literally: 'Say nyeg and enter.'
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.fout.3: Sam-guh whispers: 'I think you just have to say nyeg, boss. Nyeg.'
quest.guhs.ringh3.poort.open: Nyeg! The runes light up and the gate of Nibblemoria grinds open.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.0: The Gate of Durguh. I got it open once. I just can't remember how, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.1: Chonkus opendus! ...Nothing. Nibblum portalis! ...Nothing either. Hm.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.2: I know every spell in the tongues of guhs, Mikas and hamsters. This gate listens to none of them.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.3: 'Say nyeg and enter.' What could that mean? It must be a very deep riddle. Let me think.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.4: ...Wait a moment. It just says so, right there. You have a keyboard, don't you? Then SAY it, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.poort.open: Ha! I knew it all along. I only wanted to see if you knew it too.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.fout: CLONK. Wrong! Everything springs back, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.open: CLICK-CLACK-CLONK. The portcullis rattles up. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.niet_van_jou: The lever is stuck. This riddle isn't yours yet, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.al_gedaan: You already did this one. The portcullis opens for you.
quest.guhs.ringh3.hefboom.sam: There's a little rhyme on that stone in the middle, boss: first the sausage, then the cheese, sauce on top and the nibble last.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.hal.0: I have no memory of this place. I do remember that little rhyme. It was about food, like everything here.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.hal.1: Read the stone in the middle. And don't just go pulling things. Pippguh does that already, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.pippguh.put.0: I'm not touching anything anymore. Really. ...Is that a little lever?
quest.guhs.ringh3.pippguh.put.1: It was only a tiny bucket. It just made a very big noise.
quest.guhs.ringh3.pippguh.put.2: Guhdalf said 'fool'. But he said it with a capital letter. I heard it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.guhdalf.put: Drums. They know we're here. Help Gimguh with his door, and be quick about it!
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.wacht: A dwarf guh belongs underground. Nice and dark. Nice and close to the cheese.
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.deur.0: There's a dwarf door here, I'd bet my beard on it. You knock three times on the rune of what Durguh liked best. Only... what was that again?
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.deur.1: Bone? Sausage? Flame? I can't remember! Look at the tomb of Durguh, over there on the other side. It says so on it.
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.deur.2: Knock three times on the same rune, with no other one in between. A dwarf door is precise, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.gimguh.open: See! A dwarf guh never forgets a door. For a moment at most.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rune.fout: Knock. %s? Nothing happens with that one. Again, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rune.open: KNOCK. KNOCK. KNOCK. A piece of wall slides aside: Gimguh's secret passage. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh3.rune.sam: That tomb says what Durguh loved most, boss. It's yellow and it has holes in it.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rog.trommels: Doom... doom... Drums in the deep. Something is coming.
quest.guhs.ringh3.rog.vlucht: THE BARBECUEROG! RUN! Across the Crumble Path, to the bridge!
quest.guhs.ringh3.brug.weg: The bridge is gone. So is Guhdalf. You can't get through here for now, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh3.brug.heel: The dwarf guhs of old built to last forever: the Bridge of Nibble-dûm is back in place already.
quest.guhs.ringh3.na_brug: Guhdalf has fallen. Sam-guh sniffles. Come: up the long stairs, and outside.
quest.guhs.ringh3.araguh.einde: We made it through. Not all of us... But the ring is safe, and Guhdalf would want us to keep walking. Gimguh carved a few more runestones out of the wall for you. As a keepsake.
quest.guhs.ringh3.araguh.na: Satay Grove isn't far now. That's where Guhladriel has her home. She'll know what to do, and she has nibbles.
quest.guhs.ringh3.klaar: Chapter 3 is done: you made it through the Mines of Nibblemoria. On to Satay Grove!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.uitleg: Chapter 3 of the Nibble Ring. Under the Charcoal Flats lies the old mine of the dwarf guhs: a gate with a riddle, levers, a well you'd better not drop anything into, and very deep down something that has been smoldering for ages.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.stap.3: The guard room with the well
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.0: Walk with Sam-guh to the Mines of Nibblemoria, under the Charcoal Flats. The Super Compass (My Story) shows the way.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.0: The Guhbarbecuether, quite a walk from Guhvendell
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.1: The gate is shut tight. A spell glows above the door: 'Say nyeg and enter.' Type the word in chat, or click the glowing runes and pick the right answer.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.2: Four levers, one right order. Read the little rhyme on the stone in the middle of the hall and pull them in that order. Wrong? Then you simply start over.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.2: The Hall of Levers, down the stairs from the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.3: The portcullis is open. Walk on to the guard room with the well. And don't let Pippguh touch anything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.3: Through the portcullis, to the west
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.4: The corridor has caved in and the drums are coming closer. Gimguh knows a dwarf door: knock three times on the rune of what Durguh liked best of all. His tomb is in the same room.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.4: The west wall of the guard room
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.5: Through the Hall of Pillars, across the Crumble Path and the Bridge of Nibble-dûm. Keep walking: the Crumble Path drops away under your pawsies and the Barbecuerog is coming after you. He won't do a thing to you, he only sends you back to the Rest Fire.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.5: The Hall of Pillars, deep in the mine
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.6: Guhdalf has fallen into the deep. Climb the long stairs to the East Gate and talk to Araguh outside.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.nu.klaar: You made it through the Mines of Nibblemoria. Without Guhdalf, but with the ring. Sam-guh knows the way to Satay Grove.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.waar.klaar: Satay Grove: the Mirror of Guhladriel
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.0: Walk to the Mines of Nibblemoria
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.1: Solve the riddle of the gate: what do you have to say?
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.2: Pull the four levers in the order of the rhyme
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.3: Walk into the guard room with the well
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.4: Knock three times on the right rune (look at the tomb of Durguh)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.5: Run! Across the Crumble Path and the bridge to the other side
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h3.kort.6: Climb the long stairs and talk to Araguh outside
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.0: From Guhvendell the company crossed the black Charcoal Flats: nine travelers, one Nibble Ring and far too few provisions.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.1: Over the mountain was no good. Around it took too long. So only one way was left: underneath.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.2: Under the flats lie the Mines of Nibblemoria, where the dwarf guhs once dug for cheese gold. Until they dug too deep and woke something up.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h3.regel.3: Nobody remembers what. 'Probably nothing,' said Pippguh. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.begin: An old guard room. A well. And on the edge... a little bucket.
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.emmertje: Ooh. Do you think there's still some nibble in there?
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.dwaas: Fool of a Pippguh! Throw yourself in next time, and rid us of your snacking!
scene.guhs.ringh3_emmer.weg: Drums in the deep. They are coming! There's a dwarf door here, only... which rune was it again?
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.ogen: And in the dark of the Deep Gate, two eyes opened.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.barbecuerog: A Barbecuerog. A demon of charcoal and fire from the ancient world.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.vijand: This foe is beyond any of you. To the bridge! Run!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.brug: Across the Crumble Path! Keep walking, it's dropping away under your pawsies!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.omkijken: Don't look back, don't look back... I'M LOOKING BACK! NYEG!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.gooien: Nobody tosses a dwarf guh! ...Oh, all right, just this once.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.dienaar: I am a servant of the Secret Fire, keeper of the flame of the Big Nibble!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.schaduw: Go back to the Shadow, flame of the Barbecue!
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.weg: And he was gone. Pointy hat and all.
scene.guhs.ringh3_brug.verder: Come. He would want us to keep walking. Up the long stairs, and outside!
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_po: Solve the riddle of the Gate of Nibblemoria
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_em: Be there when a little bucket falls into the well
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_ge: A Quick Trip into the Deep
Fall into the Chasm of Nibblemoria. Sam-guh will fish you back out
Get caught by the Barbecuerog's bratwurst whip
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_br: Stand with Guhdalf on the Bridge of Nibble-dûm
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h3_kl: Make it through the Mines of Nibblemoria
structure.guhs.knabbelmoria.tooltip: The old mine of the dwarf guhs under the Charcoal Flats. Only for those who get the gate open (Guhbarbecuether)
